title: Accreditation of Islamic Religious Teachers under Asatizah Recognition Scheme
what_it_is: Accreditation of Islamic Religious Teachers under Asatizah Recognition Scheme

sections.label: ARS renewal training requirement
sections.summary: In January 2015, ARS required asatizahs to renew every three years by completing 30 hours of training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In January 2015, ARS was enhanced with the introduction of a further requirement for ARS asatizahs to attain ARS renewal every three years by completing 30 hours of training.

sections.label: Asatizahs under ARS from 2017
sections.summary: From 1 January 2017, all asatizahs providing religious guidance and Islamic education must be under ARS, with one year to qualify.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: With effect from 1 January 2017, all asatizahs who provide religious guidance and Islamic education will be required to be under ARS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: MUIS and PERGAS will continue to reach out and offer additional training to those who do not yet qualify under ARS to facilitate their registration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: They will have up to one year to qualify.

sections.label: Additional measures under AMLA
sections.summary: The Administration of Muslim Law Act already gives MUIS broad powers, but additional measures will be provided if necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Administration of Muslim Law Act already provides MUIS with broad powers, but we will Page: 22 provide for additional measures, if necessary.

sections.label: Rules for Islamic education providers
sections.summary: MUIS will put in place rules and regulations so Islamic education providers, including private ones, engage only ARS teachers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To the Member's second question, MUIS will also put in place rules and regulations to make sure that our Islamic education providers, including the private Islamic education providers, engage only ARS teachers.

sections.label: Regulatory measures for flouting centres
sections.summary: Centres that flout the regulations will face some regulatory measures.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Centres that flout the regulations will, in fact, face some regulatory measures.

sections.label: MUIS and MOM cooperation
sections.summary: MUIS works together with MOM to ensure that those invited in will meet our requirements.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: MUIS works together with MOM to ensure that those who are invited in will meet our requirements.
